name: search_document
description: Full-text search over the attached reference document. Returns matching section headings, subsection numbers, and excerpt snippets ranked by relevance. Use for locating policy language before synthesis.

query.description: Search terms or natural language question to locate in the document.

max_results.description: Maximum number of snippets to return (1-15).

name: list_sections
description: Return the table of contents for the reference document with section numbers, appendix labels, and titles.

name: extract_obligations
description: Extract mandatory requirements (must/shall/required/prohibited) from a named section or appendix of the reference document.

section_id.description: Section identifier such as '2.3', 'SECTION 12', or 'APPENDIX B'.

name: compare_retention_periods
description: Compare retention periods, classification levels, and custodians across two or more record classes from Section 11.2.

record_classes.description: Record class IDs or labels, e.g. ['RC-004', 'RC-001', 'security logs'].

name: draft_audit_checklist
description: Generate an audit checklist for a compliance domain based on Section 12 controls and Appendix C procedures.

name: map_control_matrix
description: Look up entries in the Section 12 compliance control matrix by control ID prefix, policy section, or owner team.

filter.description: Control ID (e.g. CTRL-AC-02), policy ref (e.g. 3.2), or owner name (e.g. Security).

name: lookup_jurisdiction_rules
description: Return jurisdiction-specific obligations from Section 13 and cross-border transfer requirements for a region pair.

origin_region.description: Required when jurisdiction is cross_border, e.g. 'EU'.

destination_region.description: Required when jurisdiction is cross_border, e.g. 'US'.

name: classify_vendor_tier
description: Classify a subprocessor into Tier 1/2/3 per Appendix D based on data types processed and volume.

name: get_approval_requirements
description: Return required approvers from Appendix B for a described action such as large PII export or model training.

action_description.description: Plain-language description of the proposed action.

name: trace_system_inventory
description: Look up systems of record from Section 14 by system name or record class ID.

query.description: System name (e.g. CRM-Core) or record class (e.g. RC-004).

name: build_dsar_timeline
description: Compute DSAR acknowledgment and fulfillment deadlines from Section 18 for a request type and jurisdiction.

name: synthesize_risk_register
description: Aggregate identified compliance gaps across conversation turns into a prioritized risk register with CAP suggestions.

max_risks.description: Maximum number of risks to return (3-10).

include_controls.description: Whether to map each risk to relevant CTRL-* IDs.
